get.description: Proposed public SSE envelope over existing streaming. With no cursor, send a current durable snapshot, then live changes without a subscription gap. With a cursor, replay later events in order, then continue live. Delivery is at least once; deduplicate event IDs. Expired/unavailable cursors return 410 before streaming; read status and reconnect without the cursor. Do not silently replay all history. A lost connection is not a terminal outcome. After headers are sent, a transport failure closes the stream; reconcile using GET status. Suggested heartbeat: 15 seconds; retention duration remains a deployment policy.
